name: una-moderno-workspace
description: Una Moderno — a portable editorial layout system for the independent web.

scripts.build: npm run build:art && npm run build:tokens && npm run build:core && npm run build:tailwind && npm run build:astro
scripts.lint: stylelint "packages/*/src/**/*.css" "packages/tailwind/theme.css" "packages/core/assets/fonts.css" "examples/tailwind/src/**/*.css" && node --check scripts/build-core.mjs && node --check scripts/build-art.mjs && node --check scripts/build-tailwind.mjs && node --check scripts/serve.mjs && node --check scripts/check-links.mjs && node --check scripts/generate-tokens.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:links
